notes: Control for arXiv:2608.15938 with the authors' real-robot architecture: DINOv3 ViT-B/16 double encoder (short range 2, dropout 0.3, encoder LR x0.1) and cross-attention U-Net (256/512/1024), EMA, DDIM-10. Short context (2 frames 100 ms apart), long open-loop execution (24 steps = 0.8 s), fixed 1.5 s prediction with past tokens, per-step delta actions. 200k steps at 12 per GPU x 4 GPUs = 48; 5 held-out episodes; best of the 5 lowest validation-DDIM-MSE checkpoints served.
